name: The Spider God

angles.text: As a troll, uncovering the ancient names revered by the Witherbark brings you face to face with the darker loa worshipped among distant tribes.

faq.answer: Master Gadrin seeks the name of the deity worshipped by the forest trolls.
faq.q: Who asks you to find the name of the spider god?

aliases: how to learn the spider god name
faq.answer: You find the name by reading from the Tablet of Theka.
faq.q: Where is the spider god's name recorded?

aliases: which trolls worship the spider god
faq.answer: The Witherbark tribe of forest trolls reveres the spider god.
faq.q: Which tribe worships the spider god?

sections.body: The Tablet of Theka preserves lore that Master Gadrin needs to understand the faith of the Witherbark trolls. Seeking out the stone tablet will reveal which ancient entity holds sway over their rituals, before you journey back to the witch doctor with your discovery.
sections.title: Words on Stone

summary: Master Gadrin sends you to uncover the name of the spider god worshipped by the Witherbark tribe. To learn it, you must decipher the ancient writings carved upon the Tablet of Theka.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Spider God
